read.thesis: Magna Q1 CY26 margin rose 190bp to 5.4% and FY guidance was held, but North America and Europe production cuts of 100k and 200k units and a flat Q2 margin outlook temper the read.

triggers.label: NA production cut 100k units
triggers.quote: we reduced our North American production forecast by around 100,000 units to $14.9 million, and we reduced Europe by 200,000 units

triggers.label: FY guide held; sales range trimmed
triggers.quote: We are reaffirming our prior outlook ranges for adjusted EBIT margin, adjusted EPS and free cash flow.

triggers.label: Q2 margin guided flat y/y
triggers.quote: adjusted EBIT margins expected to be relatively flat with the second quarter of last year

guidance.quote: Adjusted EPS between $6.25 and $7.25 per share
free cash flow between $1.6 billion and $1.8 billion

red_flags.label: Q1 FCF flattered by $450M+ balance-sheet EV recoveries
red_flags.quote: Operating cash flow in the current period includes over $450 million in balance sheet-related customer recoveries for certain EV programs in North America.

red_flags.label: Memory chip pricing pressure
red_flags.quote: there's more of an issue around price, meaning you may have had some contracts and basically memory providers are coming back and asking for closer to spot

evasions.quote: the best time to get through that without confusing anything is the November Investor Day
I would like to remain a businessman and a capital allocator and not a policy commentator
